text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day near the end of June...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At Etsuko Otonashi's invitation, we go to

spectate the Takarazuka Kinen—the
Grand Prix
race of the spring season.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The runners have entered the
backstretch, vying
for the mantle of this
year's Grand Prix!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka is the fan favorite for this
race.
She's been on a winning streak
since her return
from Hong Kong.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
However, she's up against the previous

Umamusume of the Year, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
This race will certainly be a turning point
in
Silence Suzuka's career.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's become a showdown between the
seemingly
unstoppable Silence Suzuka,
and Air Groove, the
Umamusume of the
Year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Considering her achievements last year, I
came in
expecting Air Groove to have
the advantage,
but...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka is in the lead as the
runners enter
the final stretch! However,
Air Groove is quickly
closing in from the
outside!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
But in the end, it's Silence Suzuka!
Silence Suzuka
makes one final push and
crosses the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! She crossed the finish line
without
anybody passin' her! Suzuka sure
knows how to
run!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe it... To think she was
powerful
enough to beat even someone
like Air Groove...

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Make no mistake—at this moment,
Silence Suzuka
is no less than a top-class
runner!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Combined with her undeniable talent,
Silence
Suzuka's victory over an
Umamusume of the Year
like Air Groove
is sure to leave a lasting
impression.
